layout: 2 columns, 2 rows: soprano sheng, alto/tenor sheng, bass sheng, pipa
references: User supplied sheng and pipa product photographs; existing cute atlas used only as style reference.
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Create a NEW replacement artwork sheet for a cute musical-instrument selection interface. Input 1 is SHAPE REFERENCE ONLY, a product-photo sheet of sheng instruments. Input 2 is SHAPE REFERENCE ONLY for slender pipa. Input 3 is STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, the current warm cute illustrated instruments. Do not reproduce any webpage text, prices, logos, banners, grid, stands, or screenshot content.

Produce a square transparent-background artwork sheet, exactly TWO COLUMNS by TWO ROWS. Four distinct full instrument illustrations, one centered in each quarter, with at least 15% empty space around each instrument within its quarter and clearly separated. Do not let any object touch a quadrant boundary. The four subjects:
TOP LEFT: SOPRANO KEYED SHENG following the TOP ROW of input1: slender vertical bundle of black lacquer pipes with stepped asymmetric rising silhouette, visible delicate silver/gold key rods, small rounded silver wind chamber at bottom, and bent blowpipe to the side. Black pipes, silver base. NOT a round pot with bamboo stalks, NOT organ pipes in a semicircle. Faithful modern keyed sheng profile.
TOP RIGHT: ALTO SHENG following BOTTOM LEFT of input1: a compact GOLDEN RECTANGULAR BOX with subtle openwork floral grille on front, many slim SILVER METAL upright pipes extending above it, the pipe heights tall at both sides and dipping in the middle to a U-shaped skyline. The gold box has two tiny friendly eyes, slight smile and rosy cheeks. Keep recognizably rectangular cabinet body.
BOTTOM LEFT: BASS SHENG following BOTTOM MIDDLE of input1: larger SILVER rectangular cabinet with delicate cutout grille, taller silver pipes rising at sides and lower center, U-shaped skyline, a few front horizontal supports and small feet. Soft charcoal outlines, cream-silver metal, two tiny eyes and smiling face integrated on front. It must look distinct from black soprano and gold alto.
BOTTOM RIGHT: PIPA following input2: a truly LONG SLENDER elongated pear body, narrow long taper up to fretted neck, bent headstock with FOUR pegs, four straight strings, small lower bridge. Overall height approximately 3.8 times maximum body width. Light honey spruce face, dark warm rosewood edge and neck, very understated floral detail. Do NOT make a round short lute: it must be substantially more slender than a liuqin. Tiny happy face and blush on lower body without hiding strings.

Art style closely follows input3: charming delicate hand-painted gouache picture-book instrument portraits, lovely realistic material hints but simplified friendly faces, warm light, cocoa outlines, small rosy cheeks. Friendly/cute comes from face and softness, NOT distorting each instrument's important proportions. Keep detailed but readable and uncluttered at icon sizes. No large eyes, no hands/legs, no extra objects, no words, labels or numbers. Transparent background, no backdrop squares, no ground platform or heavy shadow. All FOUR full instruments uncut, all exactly in their assigned quarters.
